notes: Every file EchoForge is allowed to download, pinned to an immutable revision with a verified size and SHA-256. Nothing outside this file may be fetched. Each digest below was checked against the publisher's own index, and every entry except the 1.6 GB model weight file was additionally downloaded and hashed locally on the verified_utc date. faster-whisper's convenience alias 'large-v3-turbo' resolves to mobiuslabsgmbh/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo, which the Hugging Face API now redirects to dropbox-dash/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo: the alias moved, exactly as the architecture plan warned it could. The resolved repository and commit are recorded here and the alias is never used at runtime. Silero VAD is deliberately absent as a separate entry because faster-whisper 1.2.1 ships it inside its own wheel as faster_whisper/assets/silero_vad_v6.onnx (1245151 bytes), so the wheel's digest already covers it. See docs/PHASE2B_PASS1_REPORT.md for what remains unpinned and why.

artifacts.provenance: PyPI faster-whisper 1.2.1, the pure-Python wheel. revision is the commit behind SYSTRAN/faster-whisper tag v1.2.1. Downloaded and hashed locally; size and digest match the PyPI index. This wheel also contains faster_whisper/assets/silero_vad_v6.onnx (1245151 bytes), so no separate Silero VAD artifact exists or is needed.
artifacts.runtime_version: faster-whisper 1.2.1; declares ctranslate2>=4.0,<5, av>=11, onnxruntime>=1.14,<2, tokenizers>=0.13,<1, huggingface-hub>=0.21, tqdm; Python >=3.9

artifacts.provenance: PyPI ctranslate2 4.8.1, the CPython 3.12 Windows x64 wheel. revision is the commit the annotated tag v4.8.1 points at in OpenNMT/CTranslate2. Downloaded and hashed locally; size and digest match the PyPI index. The wheel carries no LICENSE in its dist-info, so the retained text was taken from the repository at that same commit.
artifacts.runtime_version: CTranslate2 4.8.1 for CPython 3.12 on Windows x64; satisfies faster-whisper's ctranslate2>=4.0,<5

artifacts.provenance: PyPI av 18.0.0, the cp311-abi3 Windows x64 wheel, which is the wheel CPython 3.12 resolves to; 18.0.0 publishes no cp312-specific wheel. revision is the commit behind PyAV-Org/PyAV tag v18.0.0. Downloaded and hashed locally; size and digest match the PyPI index. PyAV bundles FFmpeg shared libraries, whose own notices are a Phase 6 redistribution review item.
artifacts.runtime_version: PyAV 18.0.0 for CPython 3.11+ on Windows x64; satisfies faster-whisper's av>=11

artifacts.provenance: CTranslate2 FP16 conversion of openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo. Reached through faster-whisper's alias 'large-v3-turbo' -> mobiuslabsgmbh/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo, which Hugging Face now resolves to dropbox-dash/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo; the resolved repository and commit are pinned here and the alias is never used at runtime. Size and digest are the Git LFS object metadata published by the host, which is the content digest of the file; this is the only entry not additionally downloaded and hashed locally, because it is 1.6 GB.
artifacts.runtime_version: CTranslate2 4.8.1 / faster-whisper 1.2.1; weights stored FP16, compute type selectable at load
